research_scope: Reverse Mabakusenko classification and acquisition audit.

counter_taxonomy.reason: Current Counter Skill taxonomy explicitly lists Reverse Mabakusenko under Universal Counter.

acquisition.independent_support: Dragon Ball Wiki identifies Skill Shop as the Future Warrior acquisition route.

ultimate_finish_required.reason: The documented route is Skill Shop rather than a PQ reward, so a PQ Ultimate Finish condition is not applicable and no boolean is inferred.

damage_policy.reason: Version-sensitive damage percentage is not promoted to canonical data.

audit_conclusion: No correction required. Batch 86 remains consistent with current classification and acquisition evidence.
verification_note: Reverified the retained Ultimate / Ki Blast identity, Universal Counter classification, 300 Ki cost, CaC usability, and Skill Shop acquisition. Independent community evidence continues to describe Reverse Mabakusenko as a counter Ultimate and specifically as a universal/both-type counter; a contemporary 2016 discussion also identifies it as a Skill Shop purchase. No PQ Ultimate Finish condition applies to the documented Skill Shop route.
